fixtureBoundary.conditionalComponentProof: A controlled fixture may explicitly model a sufficient, prior, owner-bound policy relation and native producer history, and test that the existing path preserves/uses those premises. Artificial symbols are test premises, not a real-model taxonomy or evidence of production eligibility. Bind any such premise before assessor launch and use the canonical published-role/proof-owner path; do not introduce a production caller-policy override or bypass to make the fixture pass.
fixtureBoundary.limitation: That is conditional mechanism proof. It cannot be reported as proof that current production policy has selected an eligible actual author/assessor pair. If the requested positive means a genuinely eligible concrete pair under current published policy, its prerequisite remains missing.

existingTestEvidence.meaning: Explicit controlled transport conservation, not independent semantic assessment; its external fixture activation disclaims semantic independence.
Native-provenance placeholder and synthetic component attribution premises; not a prior admitted eligible author/family declaration.

fixtureBoundary.finiteDiscriminator: Given an expressly scoped conditional policy premise, retain one actual prior native C1 producer and one assessment through the existing owner path; cold projection recovers both identities from their bindings. Nearest negatives: same declared family despite renamed role/model; unknown family/profile; effective-model mismatch; missing/foreign producer or scope; and forged binding/ref. Every required unknown/prohibited case stops before dependent provider execution and cannot replay green.

familyCorrespondenceOwnership.governingChangeBoundary: An exception to same-family non-independence or changed acceptance meaning requires its governing claim-policy re-entry; neither is selected here. Repeating the existing default requires no exception.
familyCorrespondenceOwnership.nextStep: Implement the selected Q23 identity/projection/refusal cone now with conditional component proof. Retain concrete positive production eligibility as an explicit pending policy/selection dependency. It can open when the exact pair's authoritative correspondence and the available actual transport route match; this is not a permanent unavailability conclusion.

unavoidablePrerequisite.condition: For an unconditional positive eligibility claim, the governing role owner must supply the exact selected profile identities and source-grounded family/independence relation for that pair before invocation. Only the relevant pair is needed; no universal taxonomy or registry is required.
unavoidablePrerequisite.splitEffect: This limits positive acceptance; it does not make the Q23/QR02 architecture split incoherent and does not require importing external reconstruction into Q23.
unavoidablePrerequisite.lawfulContinuation: Keep bounded Q23 implementation and unknown/negative behavior selected. Label any prospective synthetic eligible fixture as conditional mechanism proof. Retain actual concrete positive eligibility as pending until an existing authoritative declaration is supplied or the owning policy is lawfully selected. Do not silently treat test premises as that selection.
